html: finally. print debugging agents were killing me, burning tokens on console.logs they never clean up. this is the way

author: Viktoria Evdokimova
html:
Thanks! Agreed on the cleanup: a breakpoint is gone the moment the session ends, a println has a way of surviving into the PR.

Small caveat so nobody over-reads it: this is one bug and two runs. The pattern held here (fact first, then a narrow fix), but I’d want to see it on your own bugs before calling it “the way”.
